jobs.description:
Team/division description:

Lexus, One Omnichannel Experience (Lexus, OCX) is the Function that is the promoting the LEXUS brand 360 degree and delivers one seamless omnichannel experience across physical and digital touchpoints. The Function brings under one roof Divisions such as Lexus Brand, Digital Experience & E-Commerce, Data Platforms & Customer Engagement Management (CEM), Customer Relations, Strategy & Performance, and One Academy. Its mission is to define and connect every customer touchpoint across the ONE TOYOTA Ecosystem in an omnichannel way to drive conversion, loyalty and monetisation. AI based automation and self-services are unlocking cost efficiencies, while a system of actionable insights is leading to continuous performance improvements. A unified, centrally governed and legally compliant data foundation is the key enabler for building long term trusted relationships with our customers.

Due to its multiple impact across the business, the function should collaborate seamlessly with other TME functions and NMSCs as the primary implementer.

Your task:  

 
• 
Agenda, Mailbox, Expense & Travel Management: Manage the Function Head's agenda, mailbox, travel booking, and expenses.

 
• 
Team Travel & Expenses: Support team Heads with travel and expenses upon request.

 
• 
Travel Coordination: Share travel-related information across the function.

 
• 
All Team meeting organization: Organize Quarterly All Team meeting – book venue, collect and consolidate presentations from each team, present team related content.

 
• 
Weekly Direct reports meeting / Bi-Weekly Lexus Team Meeting: set-up meeting (including meeting room), consolidate PowerPoint presentation for the meetings, create midterm agenda visibility.

 
• 
Off-site Meetings: Coordinate logistics, including hotels, catering, venues, and registration.

 
• 
Events: Organise Christmas parties and team-building activities.

 
• 
Mailing Lists & Org Charts: Keep mailing groups and organisation charts up to date.

 
• 
Office Management: Coordinate daily office operations, meeting rooms, and group calendars.

 
• 
(Oracle Finance system) PR/PO & Supplier Creation: Create PR/Pos when needed (such as special office supply ordering, Teambuilding down payment)

 
• 
Facilities: Coordinate facility matters, locker lists, and Kara-Kara clean-up activities.

 
• 
Ad-hoc Support: Support team members with ad-hoc requests.

 
• 
One Team Sprit: Support the leadership team in building a One Team Sprit considering the diversity of the divisions.

 
• 
Reliable, Accurate & Proactive: Attention to detail, highly precise, strong organisational skills.

 
• 
Persistent, Stress-resistant & Hard-working: Focused and resilient in a demanding environment.

 
• 
Team Player and Independent Worker: Collaborates well and manages tasks independently.

 
• 
Multicultural Communication: Communicates effectively in diverse environments.

 
• 
Results-driven: Turns objectives into clear, tangible actions.

 
• 
Communication and Presentation Skills: Communicates clearly and professionally.

 
• 
Planning and Organisation: Manages priorities and multiple tasks efficiently.

 
• 
Discreet: Handles confidential information professionally and with high integrity.

 
• 
Microsoft Office Skills: Good knowledge of Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, SharePoint, Teams.

 
• 
Fluent in English: Other languages are an asset.

Are you looking for an active night shift job in a cold (-22°C) and stable working environment?
Then this might be your new challenge!

You will be working for a rapidly growing logistics company that distributes frozen products.

As an Order Picker, you are an indispensable link in the logistics process. You ensure that orders are prepared and shipped without errors.

- You collect frozen products using a pick list and scanner.
- You stack boxes correctly on pallets according to the instructions.
- You prepare orders for shipment and place pallets in the correct location.
- You work with an electric pallet truck.
- You strictly follow safety and quality rules.
- Vaardigheden:
You have experience as an order picker or logistics employee.
You are familiar with working with an electric pallet truck.
You can work without any problems in a frozen environment of -22°C.
You enjoy active work.
You work accurately, are reliable, and think in terms of the team.

- Attesten:
Certificate for electric pallet truck is a plus, but not mandatory.

- Opleidingsvereisten:
No diploma required.

- Talenkennis:
Good knowledge of English

Bedrijfsomschrijving 

This company repackages and stores frozen and chilled food products for numerous European businesses. These services are tailored to the specific needs of each customer. By 2025, the company aims to employ more than 300 people, who together handle 25,000 unique packaging orders. Working for this company means being part of a respectful environment where strong teamwork and dedication to the job go hand in hand.

Your responsibilities as a Reach Truck Operator include:

 
• 
Carrying out inspections and checks on incoming and outgoing goods.

 
• 
Placing incoming products in the correct locations within the warehouse and preparing outgoing goods for shipment.

 
• 
Scanning products into the system once they have been stored in the appropriate location.

 
• 
Primarily operating a reach truck, while also being comfortable using a forklift truck and pallet truck when required.

Interested? Read on to find out if you qualify!

 
• 
You are ready to work in the fixed nightshift.

 
• 
You hold a valid reach truck certificate.

 
• 
You already have some experience operating a reach truck. Stacking goods up to 10 meters high does not intimidate you.

 
• 
You are able to communicate in English with your colleagues.

 
• 
You will be working in a frozen warehouse at -18°C, operating an enclosed, heated reach truck. Appropriate protective clothing will also be provided by the company.

About the job
 

As a Patent Paralegal, you will provide administrative support for formal patent procedures in Belgium, Europe and abroad. Your responsibilities will include:
 
 

• Corresponding with clients, foreign agents and patent granting authorities such as the European Patent Office 

• Registering and following up on patent-related deadlines 

• Monitoring worldwide changes in procedural matters and implementing these changes in our procedures 

• Coordinating the filing of patent applications 

• Carrying out general administrative tasks  

About you
 

We are looking for someone who:
 
 

• Holds a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree 

• Has a strong judicial affinity 

• Has excellent written and oral communication skills in Dutch and English; other languages are a plus 

• Handles confidential matters with discretion 

• Has excellent Microsoft Office skills 

• Is proactive, takes initiative and knows how to set priorities 

• Has strong attention to detail 

• Can work both independently and as part of a team 

• Ideally has some experience as a Patent Paralegal, although this is not required

jobs.occupation: Food Production Operator (Early, Late or Night Shift)
jobs.description:
What will you do as a Packaging Operator in the Food Industry?
 

 
• Operate, set up and monitor packaging and weighing machines
 
• Check the quality and correct weight of packaged products
 
• Identify and resolve minor malfunctions or report them in a timely manner
 
• Perform quality control checks, including metal detection tests
 
• Help maintain a clean, safe and organized working environment 

 
• Experience as an operator or with packaging machines is an advantage, but not required
 
• You work accurately and have a strong eye for quality
 
• You speak Dutch, French, or English
 
• A forklift certificate is a plus
 
• You are willing to work in a chilled environment (5°C to 10°C)
 
• You are willing to work in shifts (6:00 AM to 2:00 PM, 2:00 PM to 10:00 PM, or 10:00 PM to 6:00 AM)

What are your responsibilities as a forklift driver?
 

 
• Receiving and correctly storing incoming goods in the warehouse
 
• Loading and unloading trucks
 
• Scanning products in and out using a scanning system
 
• Operating a forklift (approximately 80% of the time) and an electric pallet truck (approximately 20%)
 
• Maintaining a clean, safe, and organized workplace
 
• Working in a chilled environment with a closed and heated forklift 

 
• You hold a valid forklift certificate
 
• You have experience stacking and working at heights of up to 10 meters
 
• You speak Dutch, French, or English
 
• You work accurately and value order and structure
 
• Safety is always your top priority
 
• You enjoy working independently but also function well within a team

As an Account Manager, you will be responsible for growing the company's presence in Belgium by identifying opportunities, managing client portfolios, and driving commercial success.

Client Details

Join an innovative and fast-growing technology company that helps organizations optimize their digital document and information management processes. With a strong reputation in its sector and a customer-centric approach, the company continues to expand its presence across the Belgian market.

Description

• Develop and expand the Belgian market through active business development.
• Build and maintain strong relationships with existing and prospective clients.
• Identify client needs and propose tailored solutions.
• Manage the full sales cycle from prospecting to contract negotiation.
• Collaborate with internal teams to ensure excellent customer satisfaction.
• Monitor market trends and identify new growth opportunities.
• Represent the company during client meetings and networking events.

• Proven experience in a B2B Account Management or Business Development role.
• Fluent in French OR Dutch, with a good command of English.
• Strong commercial mindset and excellent negotiation skills.
• Autonomous, proactive, and results-driven.
• Comfortable developing a market and creating business opportunities.
• Experience within technology, software, SaaS, services, or solutions sales is a strong advantage.

Safran Aircraft Engine Services Brussels is a subsidiary of Safran Aircraft Engines, based at Brussels Airport (Zaventem & Steenokkerzeel, Belgium), specialized in the inspection, maintenance and repair (MRO) of the advanced LEAP jet engines that power the latest generation of the Airbus A320NEO & Boeing B737MAX narrow body families. The company is a key player in the integrated CFM international MRO network. With more than 75 years of experience, and up to 20 international Part 145 certifications (EASA/ FAA/ CAAC/ …), 
Safran Aircraft Engine Services Brussels is recognized as a worldwide center of expertise in the air transport industry. More than a 100 airlines, lessors, private aircraft operators and MRO partners have entrusted their engines to our company. We employ over 500 highly skilled, passionate and enthusiastic employees.

We are currently hiring an Operations Line Manager to reinforce and support our Operations teams.

Your job:
Reporting to the Operations Manager, you lead assembly, disassembly, and inspection teams within a high-performance aerospace environment. You ensure daily workshop operations run safely, efficiently, and in full compliance with customer, aviation, and Safran standards. Your focus is on delivering engine shop visit milestones on time while maintaining the highest levels of quality and safety.

Main tasks and responsibilities:

Operations & Planning

• Translate weekly production plans into daily priorities
• Manage shop floor activities to achieve on-time delivery
• Allocate workforce and resources efficiently
• Coordinate with planning and support teams
Team Leadership

• Lead and coach Team Leaders, Mechanics and Inspectors
• Drive training and performance improvement
• Support recruitment and development
• Foster teamwork and accountability
Safety & Quality

• Ensure compliance with HSE standards
• Promote a strong safety culture
• Ensure adherence to aviation quality standards
• Participate in audits and corrective actions
Performance & Continuous Improvement

• Monitor performance using QRQC
• Identify and implement improvements
• Manage quality deviations
• Optimize processes and operations

Your profile:
You are both a leader and a team player, able to inspire while collaborating with others.

• You bring expertise, holding a Bachelor or Master in Electromechanics with 3-5 years of relevant experience in an industrial environment.
• You have proven strong people management skills and the drive to take on new challenges with confidence.
• You are analytical and resilient, thriving under pressure and keeping a sharp focus on deadlines.
• You are communicative and fluent in Dutch, French and English.

Candidates must be legally authorized to work in Belgium, holding either an EU passport or a valid work & residence permit. Please note that we do not provide assistance with visa or permit applications.

As a Production Shift Supervisor, you are responsible for the daily operations of a modern packaging and production department. You lead a team of approximately 150 employees across multiple packaging lines and ensure that production targets, quality standards and customer requirements are achieved efficiently and safely.
 

You are a visible leader on the shop floor, coaching and supporting your team while continuously looking for opportunities to improve processes, efficiency and performance.
 

What will you do?
 

 
• Lead and support a large operational team, including direct supervision of team leaders.
 
• Monitor production planning, quality, safety and productivity targets.
 
• Coordinate closely with planning, logistics and maintenance teams to ensure smooth daily operations.
 
• Follow up on employee performance, coaching and development.
 
• Drive continuous improvement initiatives and operational efficiencies.
 
• Ensure products meet the highest quality standards and customer expectations. 

Who are you?
 

 
• You have experience in a supervisory role within a production, packaging or food manufacturing environment.
 
• You are a strong people manager who can motivate, coach and develop teams.
 
• You remain calm under pressure and can effectively prioritize in a dynamic environment.
 
• You have an interest in production processes and a willingness to develop your technical knowledge.
 
• You communicate fluently in Dutch and English; knowledge of Romanian is an asset.
 
• You are quality-focused, hands-on and solution-oriented.
 
• You understand the flexibility required in a fresh food environment where quality and customer service are key.

From Security Engineer to CISO, build your expertise today, lead tomorrow.
 

Our partner is a Belgian organisation with a strong and evolving IT environment, wherecybersecurity is becoming increasingly strategic.

They are looking for a Security Engineer to strengthen their security team and take an active role in securing the organisation's infrastructure, systems and cloud environment.

But this role goes beyond the technical scope.The long-term vision is to develop the right person towards a future CISO position, giving you increasing exposure to security strategy, risk, stakeholders and decision-making as you grow.
Security Engineer - Your Role
• Protect and improve the organisation'sIT infrastructure and security environment, covering networks, systems and cloud platforms.
• Manage and optimisesecurity solutionssuch as firewalls, VPNs, endpoint protection and access controls.
• Investigatesecurity incidents and vulnerabilities, helping identify the root cause and implement effective solutions.
• Take part incybersecurity projects, from infrastructure hardening to cloud security and new security technologies.
• Work closely withInfrastructure, Network and IT teamsto identify risks and strengthen the overall security posture.
• Gradually take on more responsibility aroundsecurity governance, risk and strategy, preparing you for a future leadership role.
Security Engineer - Your Profile
• 3+ years of experiencein Security Engineering, Cybersecurity, Network Security or a similar technical environment.
• Strong understanding ofnetwork and infrastructure security, including firewalls, VPNs, authentication and access management.
• Experience withAzure and/or GCPor another cloud environment.
• A hands-on mindset combined with a genuine interest insecurity strategy and risk management.
• Strong communication skills and the ambition to progressively move fromtechnical expertise towards security leadership.
• Fluent in Dutch, with a good understanding of the other language; English is also required.

Responsibilities

• Design and build high-quality software solutions within the transport management domain.
• Collaborate closely with solution designers to translate business ideas into effective applications.
• Develop secure and performant .NET Core Web APIs.
• Implement clean, maintainable code using SOLID principles and Clean Architecture.
• Maintain robust Azure DevOps pipelines and manage containerized deployments.
• Integrate backend APIs and ensure reliable data synchronization.

Requirements

• You have 5+ years of backend development with .NET, LINQ, async/await, and design patterns.
• You possess 3+ years of experience with .NET Core Web API design and development.
• You bring 3+ years of experience with Azure Cloud services, PaaS, and event-driven patterns.
• You have proven experience in unit testing and test quality automation.
• You're experienced with Clean Code, Clean Architecture, and SOLID principles.
• You possess knowledge of Azure DevOps, CI/CD, Kubernetes, and Docker.
• You bring experience with SQL and relational database design.
• You have experience with Git and professional branching strategies.
• You're proactive, solution-oriented, and able to explain technical choices clearly.
• You are fluent in English with a C2 level of Dutch or French.
Nice to Haves

• Experience with Android applications handling offline usage and synchronization.
• Knowledge of recovery and conflict handling when connectivity is restored.

jobs.occupation: Expert Business Analyst – Intelligent Automation & AI
jobs.description:
Responsibilities

• Support the business in leveraging emerging technologies to achieve operational efficiency and navigate complex realities.
• Define business expectations and establish clear links with technical implementation teams.
• Act as a spokesperson for the adoption of AI and automation within the organization.
• Analyze and describe detailed requirements for technical solutions based on business needs.
• Coordinate the implementation of cross-functional projects across different technological fields.
• Train and support business users to ensure the optimal use of new tools and systems.

Requirements

• You have 10+ years of relevant professional experience in a similar role.
• You possess experience in the implementation of AI and automation within large-scale, regulated environments.
• You bring in-depth knowledge of Project Management methodologies.
• You have a degree in Civil Engineering, Commercial Engineering, or a Master’s degree in Science.

Nice to Haves

jobs.occupation: Senior Project Manager – SAP S/4HANA & EWM Integration
jobs.description:
Responsibilities

• Lead project delivery from inception to completion, ensuring alignment with business goals and quality standards.
• Define project scope, deliverables, and resource requirements in collaboration with stakeholders and external implementation partners.
• Develop and manage comprehensive project plans, budget proposals, and risk mitigation strategies.
• Steer the functional solution design towards clean core principles and efficient system integration.
• Coordinate closely with internal IT teams and system integrators to manage the transition from legacy systems to the new platform.
• Utilize PMO tools to maintain clear documentation and provide regular reporting to senior management.
• Facilitate effective communication between business departments and technical delivery teams.

Requirements

• 8+ years of experience in project management specifically within the SAP domain.
• 8+ years of experience leading SAP Supply Chain and warehousing projects.
• Proven expertise in system integration between SAP ECC and S/4HANA EWM on a functional level.
• Extensive experience having completed at least 2 full life cycle SAP SCM implementations.
• Deep understanding of IT management methodologies such as ITIL or IT4IT.

• Strong ability to steer, influence, and cooperate with diverse business and technical stakeholders.

Nice to Haves

• Experience with SAP mobile device implementations in warehouse environments or Kardex tower integrations.
• Experience managing projects using Jira and Confluence.
• Knowledge of change management via ADKAR or SAP Activate methodologies.

jobs.occupation: Senior IT Service Delivery Manager – ITIL
jobs.description:
Responsibilities

• Manage the quality, performance, and continuous improvement of IT services within a complex and business-critical environment.
• Act as the central point of contact between business units, internal application teams, and external technology vendors.
• Ensure that agreed SLAs and OLAs are consistently met to maintain high application availability.
• Identify and address risks, structural deficiencies, and problems through proactive service monitoring and operational management.
• Lead complex service management escalations by managing diverse stakeholders and technical complexities.
• Facilitate consensus building across business and IT teams to align service delivery with operational requirements.

Requirements

• 15+ years of professional experience within the IT sector.
• 8+ years in strategic and tactical service management within large-scale organizations, including the management of external offshore teams.
• 5+ years of experience in the domain of Application Performance Management (APM).
• 5+ years of experience working within the public or semi-public sector.

• You're proficient in service management and collaboration tools such as ServiceNow, Jira, and Confluence.

jobs.occupation: Senior React Native Developer – iOS & Android
jobs.description:
Responsibilities

• Design, develop, and maintain high-quality cross-platform mobile applications using React Native.
• Build reusable, scalable, and maintainable components for iOS and Android.
• Integrate RESTful APIs and third-party services into mobile applications.
• Implement state management using technologies such as Redux, Redux Toolkit, Context API, or Zustand.
• Optimize application performance, responsiveness, memory usage, and startup time.
• Mentor developers and contribute to technical design and architectural decisions.
• Support application releases and deployments to the Apple App Store and Google Play Store.

Requirements

• You have 10+ years of experience as a React Native developer building scalable, high-performance mobile applications.
• You possess 5+ years of experience within an Agile/Scrum development context.
• You bring 5+ years of experience with CI/CD tools such as GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, or Jenkins.
• You have 3+ years of experience in the public transport domain.
• You bring 3+ years of experience in developing or maintaining e-commerce applications.
• You have extensive knowledge of state management using Redux, Redux Toolkit, Context API, or Zustand.
• You possess experience with RESTful API integration and mobile application architecture.
• You have the ability to troubleshoot and resolve complex technical issues across iOS and Android.
• You're proactive and possess strong mentoring skills.
• You are fluent in English at a C1 level.
Nice to Haves

• Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or Information Technology.

YOUR JOB IN A NUTSHELL

As Test Automation Engineer, you’ll join an enthusiastic multidisciplinary team at our HQ in Brussels to develop qualitative applications in a fast-changing IT landscape. Your role will contribute to innovations benefiting millions of clients, ensuring product and code quality from start to finish through test automation.

AND IN DETAIL

As a test automation engineer, you’ll be joining an enthusiastic multidisciplinary team. Together, you develop qualitative applications for a fast-changing IT landscape: an exciting and versatile challenge! 

• You monitor product and code quality, from start to finish
• You help determine the feature test plan and the test scope
• You focus maximum on automation of test cases
• You share your test results
• You identify and correct any sticking points and iron out any bugs
You know your way around :

• Develop and maintain automated test scripts using Java and test automation frameworks (e.g., Selenium, TestNG, JUnit, Cucumber etc.).
• Create comprehensive test plans, test cases, and test data for both functional and non-functional testing.
• Execute automated tests, analyze results, and report defects with detailed logs and steps for replication.
• Integrate test automation into CI/CD (Continuous Integration/Continuous Deployment) pipelines.
• Work with the development team to identify areas for automation and prioritize test cases.
• Debug and troubleshoot automation scripts and applications in various environments.
• Ensure the scalability, reliability, and effectiveness of automated test frameworks and tools.
• Maintain documentation for test automation frameworks, processes, and results.
• Have knowledge on the standards in software testing (ISTQB)

YOUR TALENTS AND COMPETENCES

• You’re the physical embodiment of the scrum values: involvement, focus, openness and respect, with a good dose of courage to boot
• You’re inquisitive and driven—and you’re always on the ball
• You thrive in a team environment, happily sharing your knowledge and insights
• You are quick to make connections and dare to question everything that deserves to be questioned
• You obtained your bachelor or master degree in Computer Sciences or IT 
• You have a good knowledge of Dutch or French, and great English skills
You surprise us with your experience or knowledge of the tools and/or programming languages below: 

• Java
• Selenium
• Cypress
• Gherkin
• Jmeter
• Postman
• Ruby
• PHP 
• Jenkins
• Swagger
• Gitlab
• Python

You will spend around 90% of your time in the field. Working with a colleague, you will carry out maintenance, inspections and technical interventions on specialised installations in the rail environment. Most assignments are in Antwerp, Brussels and Ghent, with additional interventions elsewhere. 
 
• Carry out preventive and corrective maintenance on technical installations. 
• Analyse and resolve mechanical, electromechanical and electrical faults. 
• Assess technical situations independently and help determine the appropriate course of action. 
• Carry out measurements, inspections and interventions using professional tools and test equipment. 
• Liaise with colleagues, engineers and project managers. 
• Depending on your experience, coordinate activities and take a leading role in the field.  
Rail experience is an advantage, but not essential. You bring a solid technical background and relevant practical experience; Buhlmann will teach you the specific installations, procedures and safety requirements of the rail environment. Experience in industrial maintenance, machine building, installation engineering or field service can be highly relevant.
 
After your induction period, you will take part in the on-call rota. Urgent night-time interventions are limited to a few occasions per year. In addition, there is on average around one planned night intervention per month, with time off in lieu afterwards.

We are looking for an experienced technician who knows the trade, can tackle technical problems independently and takes responsibility for safe, high-quality execution. 
 
• Technical qualification in electromechanics, mechanics, electricity, or equivalent experience. 
• Several years of relevant practical experience in maintenance, industrial installations, machine building, field service or a comparable technical environment. 
• Strong foundation in mechanics and electromechanics, complemented by sufficient electrical knowledge. 
• You analyse problems methodically, work independently and consult others when the situation requires it. 
• You enjoy field work and are comfortable in a role involving travel to different sites. 
• Experience as a lead technician, team leader or site supervisor is an advantage; even in such a role, you still want to remain technically involved. 
• You can communicate operationally in Dutch and/or French and have sufficient English for technical communication.

• Assemble electronic instruments and subassemblies according to drawings, specifications and work instructions. 
• Perform micro-soldering and rework under magnification. 
• Diagnose and repair PCB and component issues. 
• Handle small and delicate electronic components with precision. 
• Apply thermal grease, silicone and adhesives according to defined processes. 
• Program and configure electronic modules. 
• Perform electronic tests and in-process quality checks. 
• Identify defects or non-conformities and contribute to troubleshooting. 
• Record your work accurately to ensure full traceability. 
• Follow ESD, quality, safety and 5S procedures. 
• Learn different assembly and testing processes as production develops.  
 

 
• A technical background in electronics, electromechanics or a related field. 
• Ideally 3+ years of relevant industrial experience. 
• Practical experience with electronics assembly, soldering, PCB work, testing, repair or precision manufacturing. 
• Excellent manual dexterity and attention to detail. 
• A methodical, reliable and quality-conscious way of working. 
• A hands-on attitude: you enjoy working with the product rather than spending your day behind a desk. 
• The curiosity and flexibility to learn different tasks and processes. 
• English: Good working proficiency (minimum B1) – essential for daily communication and instructions. 
• Dutch or French: Fluency in at least one of the two languages.   
A bachelor's degree in Electronics is welcome, but not essential if you can demonstrate strong relevant hands-on electronics experience.

• Perform functional tests using dedicated test equipment. 
• Carry out visual, optical and mechanical quality checks. 
• Perform manual assembly of components and subassemblies. 
• Handle small and delicate components carefully and accurately. 
• Prepare, inspect and package finished products. 
• Follow production procedures, work instructions and checklists. 
• Identify and report defects, quality issues or non-conformities. 
• Complete production and quality documentation to ensure traceability. 
• Maintain a clean and organised workstation and follow 5S and safety rules. 
• Perform repetitive precision tasks while maintaining concentration and quality. 
• Rotate between different production activities depending on priorities. 
•  Learn new assembly, testing and production processes through on-the-job training.
 
• Technical secondary education or equivalent practical experience. 
• Ideally some experience in production, electronics, assembly, testing, packaging or another industrial environment. 
• Good manual dexterity and attention to detail. 
• The ability to follow procedures accurately while maintaining a good working pace. 
• A reliable and organised way of working. 
• A practical, hands-on attitude and team spirit. 
• Above all, the flexibility to learn and work across different production activities. 
• English: Good working proficiency (minimum B1) – essential for daily communication and instructions. 
• Dutch or French: Fluency in at least one of the two languages.   
Experience with electronics, optics or precision manufacturing is an advantage, but you do not need to be an electronics specialist. Motivated candidates with a technical background and limited production experience are also welcome to apply.

jobs.occupation: Administrative Officer - Technical Sales Support & Logistics
jobs.description:
Navision, order processing and follow-up form the core of the role – but the position is clearly broader than traditional order administration. 

As Administrative Officer – Technical Sales Support & Logistics, you are a key link between customers, suppliers and your colleagues. As you gain experience, you can also become more involved in logistics follow-up and the administrative support of technical projects.
  
• Process and follow up customer orders in Microsoft Dynamics Navision. 
• Prepare quotations, order confirmations and purchase orders. 
• Place orders with suppliers and actively follow up delivery dates. 
• Support customers with questions about parts, spare parts and service. 
• Request prices and quotations from suppliers. 
• Follow up transport, deliveries, incoming goods and stock information. 
• Work closely with sales, project managers, engineers and technicians. 
• Occasionally provide practical support with a delivery or in the warehouse.  
The practical logistics component is limited – around 5 to 10% of the role – but it reflects the way Buhlmann works: colleagues do not constantly draw a line around where one job description ends and another begins.
 
Once you know the organisation well, your responsibilities can expand towards project support, for example project files in SharePoint, material orders, delivery follow-up and administrative preparation for invoicing.

Above all, we are looking for someone who is administratively strong, takes responsibility and shows initiative. 

You preferably have relevant experience in order administration, purchasing, sales support, customer service, logistics administration or a technical sales support role. You do not need to be a technical specialist, but an interest in a technical environment is important.
  
• Experience with an ERP system; knowledge of Navision is a strong advantage. SAP or a comparable system also provides a good basis. 
• You work accurately and in a structured way and can keep several files, deliveries and deadlines under control at the same time. 
• You take initiative: if a supplier needs to be chased or a file needs further investigation, you do not simply wait. 
• You are collegial and practically minded and do not mind occasionally helping with a delivery. 
• You are fluent in Dutch and can communicate professionally in English. French is a clear advantage; German is a welcome extra.
